name: Wade - Demo
summary:
**Wade** is a realistic Fly Fishing game with rod and line physics carefully crafted, river currents and fish fights demanding all you focus to not lose a fish.

This demo is a preview of the base mechanics. Your feedback is invaluable as I continue to refine the experience for the full release.
